description: This file defines Danish (Denmark) culture information for the DateJS library, including date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and prototype extensions for Date objects.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of a Date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the Date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Checks if the date is after another date.

methods.name: isBefore
methods.description: Checks if the date is before another date.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Checks if a year is a leap year.
